This report describes the investigation of seven cases of locally acquired Plasmodium vivax malaria
Case 1. On July 24, a man aged 37 years was admitted to hospital A

methods_quotes.q: Blood specimens were reviewed, and P. vivax infection was confirmed by both microscopic diagnosis and polymerase chain reaction rRNA gene analysis.
parasite multilocus genotyping confirmed that all seven patients were infected by the same strain of P. vivax.
Targeted mosquito trapping was conducted within 1 mile of the homes of patients.
